scope: Local monochrome simple-geometry pilot with supplied ports; no plant-wide ISA certification

cases.name: unmarked crossing
cases.behavior: two straight paths; no turning connection

cases.name: native hop
cases.behavior: preserve native curve continuity; no junction with crossed line

cases.name: tee with or without filled dot
reversed direction claim
cases.behavior: reject if inconsistent with detected arrow tip/base

cases.name: unexplained break
cases.behavior: abstain; source continuity is not visible evidence

cases.name: off-page merge
cases.behavior: unsupported; no cross-sheet resolver or inferred merge; require sheet/tag/revision/legend evidence

cases.name: reducer or instrument symbol
cases.behavior: semantic interpretation unsupported; needs a reviewed symbol library and port model

review_questions: Which plant/drawing legend and revision defines each supported crossing, hop and break?
Which arrows represent process flow rather than instrument signals?
What combination of sheet, line/tag and revision uniquely matches an off-page connector?
Which equipment/nozzle ports and symbol classes are required for the first useful task?
When should ambiguous marks trigger abstention and a better drawing request?
